description: This file defines a Java record 'PayPalProperties' which encapsulates configuration properties for PayPal integration in a Spring Boot application. It is bound to properties prefixed with 'payment.paypal' from 'application.yml'.

classes.name: PayPalProperties
classes.description: A record that holds PayPal configuration properties such as enabled status, base URL, client ID, and client secret, used for configuring PayPal integration in the application.
